report_topic: Performance Audit of Implementation of Pradhan Mantri Khanij Kshetra Kalyan Yojana including District Mineral Foundation Trusts in Gujarat
observations_summary: The audit found significant underutilization of DMF funds (52.95% unutilized) and the Environmental Compensation Fund. There were delays in DMF registration, non-updation of affected area lists, and non-identification of beneficiaries. Deficiencies in project implementation included awards on nomination basis, excess payments, and project cancellations. Monitoring and evaluation were inadequate, with irregular EC/GC meetings, delayed annual reports, and no social audits conducted.
